declared_printing_policy: Require the raw declared set code to be allowed and resolve uniquely through the pinned catalog. No old-printing or reprint exemption is asserted.
sideboard_policy: The research fixture explicitly declares an empty sideboard. Historical source event sideboards were omitted and are not reconstructed.
copy_identity_policy: Unicode-normalized case-folded title plus subtitle across main and declared sideboard, irrespective of printing or finish.
scope: Conservative current Premier constructed-deck declaration admission for the pinned 27-list main-card bank, not certification of historical events, card possession, authenticity, engine support, strategic quality, or every possible construction rule.

extra_card_constraints_audit.scope: All 19 distinct source leaders and 20 bases reviewed; every used main card scanned for explicit deck-size, copy-count, and deck-construction text against pinned card metadata.

found.title: Data Vault
found.rule: Your minimum deck size is increased by 10 cards.

matching_requirements: Preserve original source family assignment and split, leader, base, and main-deck size.
Replacement cards must already occur in the original bank's main decks.
Preserve printed cost, types, arena, and aspects exactly.
Recheck the complete resulting declaration, including canonical name/subtitle copy counts and base-specific minimum.
Metadata or printing ambiguity fails admission; structural matching by itself does not establish eligibility.

sources.role: Official link to current Comprehensive Event Guide.

Official basic Premier construction overview; the more specific Event Guide and live suspension list govern this policy.

capture_provenance.method: Official Event Guide read through web PDF text extraction; live Rules page rendered in Chrome and inspected read-only.
capture_provenance.caveat: CDN direct download was unavailable; do not interpret this policy file's SHA256 as an official page/PDF byte hash. Rules v9 PDF and a general reprint exemption were not verified. No suspension effective date was exposed by the rendered list.
